text: huh.... if its not 4 sided. so anything larger or smaller t han 4 sides on a face is instant skip ?
resolution: Clarified the loop-stop rule for the user: any authored face with corner count != 4 ENDS the loop (a stop, not a skip — the non-quad isn't cut and nothing beyond it is reached); triangles, 5+-siders, and merged mega-faces all stop it, counted on the authored face not render triangles. Also named the two other stoppers with identical behavior: open borders (edge with no face on the other side) and junctions (edge shared by 3+ faces, no unambiguous continue). One-line rule given: the loop continues only while each step is one edge -> one quad -> one opposite edge. Reiterated that the proposed even-sided crossing + 'through' toggle converts these hard stops into passable when desired. Q&A only.
